name: Privilege Escalation — Admin Role Assignment Off-Hours
description: Detects Global Administrator role assignments occurring outside business hours (08:00–18:00). Severity: Critical.
query: AuditLogs | where OperationName == 'Add member to role' | where Result == 'success' | extend TargetRole = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName) | where TargetRole contains 'Administrator' | extend HourOfDay = hourofday(TimeGenerated) | where HourOfDay !between (8 .. 18)
